objective: Exclude deprecated document-api from CI, make local just ci self-contained, and create tag-aligned GitHub prerelease packages after successful main branch CI.
acceptance_criteria: CI-facing service matrices and scripts contain no document-api service.
The deprecated document-api source and local knowledge profile remain unchanged.
just ci does not require globally installed jsonschema, PyYAML, commitlint, or shellcheck.
Interactive changed-test hooks do not wait for EOF.
A successful push CI run on main creates one build-YYYYMMDD-<short-sha> tag for the merge commit.
A GitHub prerelease for the build tag contains packages for web-api, integration-api, endpoint-api, assistant-api, and ui plus SHA256SUMS.
Failed CI and pull-request CI runs create no tags or releases.
Reruns reuse a matching tag and never move a conflicting tag.
just ci and repository finalization pass.
risks: A write-enabled workflow could tag untrusted code unless restricted to successful push CI on main.
A rerun could create a conflicting tag unless tag creation is idempotent.
The assistant package can be large because native libraries and model assets must remain deployable.
Local dependency bootstrapping can become non-reproducible unless versions are pinned.
A broad document-api text check could incorrectly reject non-CI compatibility files.
rollback: Revert the tag orchestrator, reusable packaging changes, and local CI wrappers. Delete an incorrect prerelease and matching build tag only after verifying that no downstream release consumes them.
